title: Learning Activities: students rehearse presentations with Speaker Coach
summary: The roadmap facts, Learning Activities controls and product licensing are supported. The claim that many schools have left the service at its default is unsupported, and the checklist mentions an age setting without a corresponding controls-table row; neither finding blocks publication.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No licence specific to Speaker Coach practice in Learning Activities is published.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" license pricing meter'; opened Manage Microsoft 365 for Education AI Features, including its Learning Activities SKU list. No activity-specific licence found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: No price specific to Speaker Coach practice in Learning Activities is published.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" license pricing meter'; opened Manage Microsoft 365 for Education AI Features. Results described other Speaker Coach products or unrelated pricing, not a price for this activity.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No meter specific to Speaker Coach practice in Learning Activities is published.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" license pricing meter'; opened Manage Microsoft 365 for Education AI Features. No meter for this activity was found.

claims.claim: The cited Education AI features page documents no meter for Learning Activities.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" license pricing meter'; read the full Manage Microsoft 365 for Education AI Features page. Its Learning Activities section lists SKUs and controls but no meter.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; What's changing; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the arrival default for the Speaker Coach activity specifically, so defaultState is unknown.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" default rollout availability generation sign-in permissions'; read the roadmap and Education AI features page. They do not specify this activity's arrival default.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not identified which Learning Activities entry points will expose Speaker Coach practice.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" default rollout availability generation sign-in permissions'; opened Education AI features and Teams Speaker Coach. The former lists general entry points, not this activity's.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the planned Speaker Coach activity in Learning Activities.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" settings default audio retention generation practice'; opened Education AI features and Teams Speaker Coach. Results concerned the surrounding service, Teams, PowerPoint or Speaker Progress.

claims.claim: The Learning Activities switch is in Microsoft 365 admin center > Settings > Org settings > Services > Learning Activities > Turn on Learning Activities.
claims.quote:
go to Settings > Org settings.
2. In the Services tab, select Learning Activities.
3. In the Learning Activities panel, check or uncheck Turn on Learning Activities.

claims.claim: PATCH /v1.0/servicePrincipals/{id} is the Graph operation used to disable the Learning Activities service principal.
claims.quote: PATCH /servicePrincipals/{id}

claims.claim: Setting accountEnabled to false in that operation disables the service principal account.
claims.quote: | accountEnabled | Boolean | true if the service principal account is enabled; otherwise, false. |

claims.claim: A Global admin or Office Apps admin can manage the Learning Activities organisation setting.
claims.quote: You must be a Global admin or Office Apps admin to manage this setting.

claims.quote: This setting applies to your entire organization. You can’t enable or disable Learning Activities for specific users or groups.

claims.quote: Changes may take up to 24 hours to take effect across your organization.

claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" Graph PowerShell disable policy permissions rollout' and '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" settings default audio retention generation practice'; opened Education AI features and Teams Speaker Coach.

Unchecked: Learning Activities is disabled for all users in your organization.

claims.claim: Enabling generation for students aged 13 to 17 requires setting their Microsoft Entra ageGroup property to NotAdult.

claims.claim: No new sign-in or permission model is described specifically for this activity.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" default rollout availability generation sign-in permissions' and '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" Graph PowerShell disable policy permissions rollout'; opened Education AI features.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not described this Learning Activities version's audio capture and processing mechanism or processing location.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" audio storage retention privacy data controls'; opened Education AI features and Teams Speaker Coach. Results about Azure Speech and other Speaker Coach experiences did not establish this activity's audio handling.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented where this activity stores students' rehearsal audio.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" audio storage retention privacy data controls'; opened Education AI features and Teams Speaker Coach. Neither supplies audio storage details for Speaker Coach in Learning Activities.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented whether this activity retains rehearsal audio or for how long.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" audio storage retention privacy data controls'; opened Education AI features and Teams Speaker Coach. No retention statement was found for this Learning Activities activity.

claims.claim: No narrower data control is documented for the planned Speaker Coach activity.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" audio storage retention privacy data controls' and '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" Graph PowerShell disable policy permissions rollout'; read Education AI features and Teams Speaker Coach.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not said whether rehearsal in this activity counts as generation or practice for age-based availability.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" settings default audio retention generation practice'; read Education AI features and the roadmap. The general generation/practice distinction is documented but this activity is not classified.

claims.claim: Rollout mechanics for Speaker Coach in Learning Activities have not yet been published.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" default rollout availability generation sign-in permissions'; read the roadmap and Education AI features. The record gives a target month but no rollout mechanics.

claims.claim: Speaker Coach in Teams meetings processes the presenter's audio.
claims.quote: Speaker Coach in Teams meetings and events processes a user's audio while they present, as well as the audio of all unmuted participants

claims.claim: The Teams meeting policy parameter -AllowMeetingCoach governs Speaker Coach in Teams meetings and events.
claims.quote: You use PowerShell to manage Speaker Coach through the -AllowMeetingCoach parameter within the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated that -AllowMeetingCoach governs Speaker Coach in Learning Activities.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" Graph PowerShell disable policy permissions rollout'; opened Teams Speaker Coach and Education AI features. The meeting policy's documented reach is Teams meetings and events, not Learning Activities.

claims.claim: No source states that existing Learning Activities behaviour changes when this activity arrives.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" "Speaker Coach" default rollout availability generation sign-in permissions'; read the roadmap and Education AI features. Neither describes a change to existing activities' behaviour.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes student feedback and suggestions, not autonomous actions taken on students' behalf.
claims.quote: In learning activities, students can rehearse presentations, receive feedback on their delivery, and practice again with targeted suggestions to improve clarity and confidence.

claims.claim: Many schools have left Learning Activities at its default.
claims.quote: Searched: '"Learning Activities" schools adoption default enabled usage'; opened Education AI features and reviewed search results. The documented enabled default does not establish how many schools have retained it.
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence with: 'This adds students’ spoken rehearsals to Learning Activities.'

claims.where: Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: The checklist asks administrators to review the student ageGroup setting, but that control has no row in the controls table.
claims.quote: Review how students' Microsoft Entra ageGroup property is set, since Learning Activities uses it to decide generation for students aged 13 to 17. | The table contains only the Learning Activities switch and the separate Speaker Coach switch gap.
claims.fix: Remove the Before rollout checklist bullet beginning 'Review how students' Microsoft Entra ageGroup property is set'. The factual ageGroup requirement can remain in Scope.
